notes: 两个让「拉取成功却被打回」的真因一起修掉：① 后台同步原先优先用配置仓库里的 sync.ps1 当执行体，而它随仓库同步、插件升级后还是旧版（没有冲突清单、没有 exit 6），pull 被退回「直接 git pull → 冲突 Aborting → reset 回滚」，面板选的 18 项「用云端」根本没被读；现在改为插件 runtime 优先、AppRoot 下最新插件次之、仓库副本只兜底。② apply 在找不到 pnpm 时 exit 1，而 post-exit 把非零退出码当成「拉取失败」自动回滚——快进明明完成了又被整套还原；现在只要 profile 里 node_modules 已存在就按依赖就绪处理，只有真的没有依赖才报错退出。自检同步加断言防回退。
notesEn: Fixes the two reasons a pull could succeed and still be rolled back: (1) the background sync preferred the sync.ps1 inside the config repo as its executor, but that copy syncs with the repo and stayed stale after plugin upgrades (no conflict list, no exit 6), so the pull degraded to plain git pull, aborted on conflicts and reset itself — the cloud choices saved in the panel were never read; executor selection now prefers the plugin runtime, then the newest plugin under AppRoot, and the repo copy is only a fallback. (2) apply exited with 1 when pnpm was missing, and post-exit treats any non-zero code as "pull failed" and rolls everything back — the fast-forward had completed and was undone; now an existing profile node_modules counts as dependencies ready, and only a genuinely missing dependency tree fails. Self-test assertions added for both.
